name: Matthew
lede: The fortieth book of the Bible and the first of the New Testament, in full: the book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the wise-men and the star, the voice in the wilderness, the sermon on the mount, the healings and the parables of the kingdom, the transfiguration, the entry into Jerusalem, the last supper and the cross, and the empty tomb — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Son of David
books.blurb: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham: three times fourteen generations; Joseph's dream — thou shalt call his name JESUS; Immanuel, God with us; the wise-men from the east and the star that stood over the young child; gold and frankincense and myrrh; the flight into Egypt and Rachel weeping for her children; John the Baptist in the wilderness; the heavens opened and the Spirit as a dove — this is my beloved Son; forty days in the wilderness — it is written; and the fishers of men by the sea of Galilee.

books.name: The Sermon on the Mount
books.blurb: He went up into the mountain and opened his mouth and taught them: blessed are the poor in spirit; ye are the salt of the earth, ye are the light of the world; not to destroy, but to fulfil; but I say unto you — love your enemies; when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber: Our Father who art in heaven; treasures in heaven; consider the lilies of the field; judge not; ask, and it shall be given you; the narrow gate; by their fruits ye shall know them; and the house built upon the rock.
